posts.title: The Duck and the Codec
posts.description: A rubber duck works because you have to say the thought out loud and hear it arrive. An LLM is a duck that answers, and the risk is that it autotunes you until you can no longer hear your own voice.

posts.title: The Last Founder
posts.description: A $20 subscription gets anyone a landing page and a pitch deck, so the founder title stops meaning anything. The developers who matter next are the forkers: people who learned a system deeply enough to take it somewhere its owners refused to go.

posts.title: The Plan Above Your Plan
posts.description: Your AI subscription won't get more expensive. It will just stop getting better while the new plans above it do. A prediction, written down now so I can say I told you so later.
